def factor_tail_asymmetry_jump_frequency(df):
    """Downside vs upside return jump frequency, measured with lagged realized vol."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol = ret.rolling(63, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1).shift(1)
    down_jump = ((ret < -1.5 * vol) & (vol > 0)).rolling(63, min_periods=20).sum()
    up_jump = ((ret > 1.5 * vol) & (vol > 0)).rolling(63, min_periods=20).sum()
    df_copy["factor_tail_asymmetry_jump_frequency"] = -(down_jump - up_jump) / (down_jump + up_jump + 1.0)
    return df_copy["factor_tail_asymmetry_jump_frequency"]
description: Measures asymmetric volatility by the frequency of tail jumps: returns below -1.5 sigma of prior realized volatility versus returns above +1.5 sigma over a 63-day window. Downside jump propensity is an uncovered Price-Volatility Behavior pathway distinct from continuous semivol, capturing discontinuous risk aversion. Negative sign ranks downside-jump-heavy names lower.
